query: SELECT pg_current_snapshot()::text AS "text!", pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_current_snapshot())::text::bigint AS "xmin!", pg_snapshot_xmax(pg_current_snapshot())::text::bigint AS "xmax!", COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(x::text::bigint) FROM pg_snapshot_xip(pg_current_snapshot()) AS t(x)), '{}'::bigint[]) AS "xip!", (SELECT txid FROM change_horizon) AS "horizon!", (SELECT epoch FROM sync_history) AS "epoch!", (SELECT cluster = sync_identity() FROM sync_history) AS "current!"
